additional_info.subject: FW: RE: Webform_incident_SiCharge D_06-10-2025_SN: MP / P5 170000510 CRM:00346000754
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR,
There is an issue between the state monitor KF13 and QA32.
Please check the continuity on the following points:
QA32:14
XD6 7:B
XD6 7:A
XD14:1B:3
Please pay extra attention to XD:14:1B, disconnect and connect again to make sure is well connected.
​​​​​​​If there is continuity in all of them, please replace the KF13.
I will send this ticket to the RC-FR queue for the onsite troubleshooting.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
